brief:
Egypt's then-intelligence chief Abbas Kamel warned senior Israeli officials days before Hamas's 7 October attack that Gaza would "blow up in your faces" if Israel did not change course, The Atlantic reported. The warning came as part of broader Egyptian concerns about escalating tensions in the territory.

The specific details of Kamel's warning and the Israeli response remain unclear from the report. Egyptian intelligence had maintained close monitoring of the situation in Gaza ahead of the attack that killed hundreds and triggered Israel's military response.
